original_evolution.training_context: The stepwise notebook describes evolution_model.hdf5 as an older model trained on unmodified EGFP replicate 1.
original_evolution.scaler: stepwise_evolve_utrs.ipynb cell 2 uses scale_utrs = df[:40000]. Its sort_values call is not assigned or inplace, so v2 conservatively marks the first 40000 raw rows and their complete allocation units as scaler-seen.
original_evolution.historical_evaluation: Nature Fig. 3 shows the original model used to generate sequences and evaluates those measured states. Such outer pools are historical measured-state outer, never never-evaluated.

retrained_evolution.training: Nature Fig. 3d states that the original Optimus 5-Prime was retrained using sequences from the designed library.
retrained_evolution.historical_evaluation: Nature Fig. 3c shows retrained predictions on measured stepwise states; Supplementary Fig. 13 reports historical retrained/original comparisons on designed sub-libraries.
retrained_evolution.retraining_2695: The independent review requires 2695 retraining sequences to be excluded. No sequence-level list was found in the reviewed public code or supplementary text, so random, target/step designed=True and every possible retrained outer are conservatively development/quarantine.

controls: target designed=False and step designed=False trigger complete allocation-unit control roles. Linked designed=True rows are also kept out of the design pool to avoid splitting a near component.
contexts: eGFP unmod replicate 1 is the only original fixed-pool E1 context. Rep2, pseudouridine, 1-methylpseudouridine and mCherry are separate contexts and are never pooled into eGFP unmod replicate 1.
replicate_summary: E1 uses only the designated single-assay/rep1 context. Replicate measurements within a sequence/context are not independent evidence. If a future protocol uses multiple replicates, aggregate measured MRL by median within sequence/context, retain replicate count and missingness, and exclude missing values from the median.
